summary: The candidate captures the main skein-module definitions, evaluation/Khovanov lemmas, gluing theorem, and 1-, 2-, and 3-handle formulas. However, several statements are imprecise or weakened, one gluing formula omits the balanced tensor-product subscript, external attribution is inconsistent, locators and numbering are sometimes inaccurate, and proof/algorithm material is misclassified as theorem-level entries. Duplicate entries also reduce extraction quality.
strengths: Covers all principal handle-attachment results and the central gluing-isomorphism result.
Captures the core three-manifold algebra, skein-lasagna triple, functorial-link-theory conditions, and Khovanov test-case structures.
Includes several important supporting constructions and records external provenance for the Ren–Willis gluing surjection and related comparison results.
Most formulas are recognizable and mathematically aligned with the gold statements.
issues: The explicit bimodule gluing-map definition Ψ from the gold artifact is missing as a dedicated entry.

Foundational external claims such as the MWW skein-lasagna theory and the general evaluation-isomorphism result are not cleanly represented with their attribution; the evaluation item is instead typed as a calculation.
The first gluing-formula entry omits the tensor product over S*(Y;P), materially weakening the theorem statement, although a later duplicate restores this detail.
The candidate contains substantial duplication: the external gluing surjection, Khovanov lemma, and gluing theorem are each represented more than once.
The inverse-map construction and well-definedness argument are extracted as algorithm/definition/theorem entries rather than proof/inference material, causing classification errors and fragmentation.
Several handle statements are less precise than gold, especially the 2-handle cabling algebra and 3-handle quotient/action relations.
Page references and theorem numbering are inconsistent with the gold artifact; handle theorems are often assigned page 2 instead of page 1, and duplicate theorem identifiers are used.
External attribution is incomplete or inconsistent, including the Khovanov construction and one Ren–Willis citation variant.
